why: A link reference definition nobody uses renders as nothing on GitHub, and the `[//]: # (...)` shape is the common way to write a Markdown comment. The fail side is a Copilot instructions file whose unused definition carries a title that opens by naming the assistant. The body of a definition is the label, a line break and the title: joined by a space, the title no longer starts the body, and the fail side goes green (measured). The pass side uses the same label in a later paragraph, so the definition is a real link target and not a hidden region: count used definitions and the pass side goes red.
